name: photo_search
description: Search Pexels photos by keyword (required); returns paginated results with image URLs in multiple sizes, photographer name, and attribution link.

name: photo_curated
description: Fetch Pexels' curated editorial photo feed; returns paginated photo objects with image URLs in multiple sizes (original, large, medium, small, tiny) and photographer info.

name: photo
description: Fetch full metadata for a single Pexels photo by numeric id, including all sized image URLs, photographer name/URL, dimensions, and alt text.

name: video_search
description: Search Pexels videos by keyword (required); returns paginated results with video file URLs at multiple resolutions, duration, and videographer info.

name: video_popular
description: Fetch Pexels' popular video feed; returns paginated video objects with file URLs at multiple resolutions, duration, and videographer info.

name: video
description: Fetch full metadata for a single Pexels video by numeric id, including file URLs at all available resolutions, duration, width, height, and videographer attribution.

name: featured_collections
description: List Pexels' featured curated collections; returns collection id, title, description, and media counts for photos and videos.

name: collection_media
description: Fetch all photos and videos inside a specific Pexels collection by string id; returns paginated mixed media objects with URLs and metadata.
